newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish PM may reshuffle government soon - source.
newsitem.headline: Swedish PM may reshuffle government soon - source.

text.p: Swedish Prime Minister Goran Persson may be about to reshuffle the government to strengthen his cabinet, a centrally placed Social Democratic Party (SDP) source told Reuters on Friday.
"We're under the gun from internal criticism. The cabinet office is now working hard on new proposals to cut unemployment. We have to regain the initiative," the source said.
In response to the suggestion that the government would be unable to take command as long as it contained a number of weak profiles, the source said:
"There may be a government reshuffle soon. You should be on the alert for that".
